config_name: Galaxy Tab S10 Ultra — Dimensity 9300+, 12GB RAM, 1TB, 14.6" Dynamic AMOLED 2X + Slim Keyboard Cover (priced in)

specs.ports: 1x USB-C 3.2 (DP out, DeX), pogo pins for keyboard cover — no 3.5mm, no HDMI
specs.keyboard_notes: Slim Keyboard Cover for S10 Ultra/S9 Ultra (BBY 18469772) included in price: larger footprint, scissor keys, NO trackpad (trackpad only on the pricier Book Cover Keyboard); pogo-pin powered
specs.pen_support: S Pen INCLUDED in box (Bluetooth air actions, IP68)
specs.os: Android 14 (One UI 6.1) at launch; 7 years OS + security updates promised; Samsung DeX desktop mode

battery.notes: 11,200mAh. Lab Wi-Fi-web ~13-14h; users report ~10-11h mixed real use on the big panel. 45W charging.

price.notes: Bundle price = tablet (current best new retail) + keyboard, per the config definition. Components: Tab S10 Ultra 1TB $2,148.97 (BBY SKU 18390514) + Slim Keyboard S10 Ultra/S9 Ultra $136.97 (BBY 18469772) = $2,285.94 cover-in price. Cover-only price: $136.97. Only the 1TB tier is stocked new — 256/512GB are open-box/refurb only per BBY (see ANDROID_LIST.md).

offers.name: Bundle: tablet + keyboard (config price includes the keyboard). Tablet listing 2148.97 + keyboard per price.notes.

reviews.quote: Average 85.05% across 44 aggregated scores: a superb option for creative professionals with a strong processor and reliable AI features, though its Dimensity chipset lags the iPad Pro.

praises: The 14.6" AMOLED is the biggest and one of the best tablet displays ever made — DeX on it genuinely replaces a small laptop monitor (r/tabletcomputers)
1TB + microSD: a full video-editing and media archive in a 718g slate
S Pen in the box; on a canvas this size the air actions and sketching get real daily use
Galaxy phone parity + Second Screen: users pair it as a wireless portable monitor for their PC
Quad speakers on the Ultra are the loudest, most balanced tablet speakers short of an iPad Pro
complaints: At $2,300 with keyboard it is laptop money for an OS where half the apps won't window in DeX
Slim Ultra cover has no trackpad — buy the premium Book Cover Keyboard or carry a mouse
Too big for one-handed/couch use; many owners say the S10+ was the smarter size
Same Dimensity 9300+ as the S10+ — the flagship tax buys glass, not silicon
Only the 1TB tier is stocked new at CA retail now; cheaper tiers are open-box/refurb roulette

design_philosophy: The maximalist tablet: Samsung's statement that a tablet can BE the big-screen machine rather than a companion. Same silicon as the S10+ — the Ultra tax buys the spectacular 14.6" panel, bigger speakers, and this 1TB capacity tier, making it the DeX-as-laptop-replacement flagship even though Android's app gap is most visible at this price.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from the NBC-reviewed S10+ anchor per SHARED-tab-s10.md cross-config deltas: screen_size 9.0 (14.6"), portability −1.5 (718g), battery +0.5 (11.2Ah cell), productivity +0.3 (DeX real estate), keyboard_trackpad +0.5 (larger Ultra cover), creative_work +0.5 (1TB headroom + largest canvas). No verbatim pro score retrievable (bot-walls, disclosed). Image URL is BBY CDN SKU guess.
standouts: Largest premium tablet display in class — DeX on 14.6" is the closest Android gets to a desktop
1TB + microSD: no other flagship tablet ships this much local storage new
Best tablet speakers short of iPad Pro, with S Pen included
dealbreakers: $2,286 with keyboard is MacBook Pro money for a platform with a real desktop-app gap
Priced-in Slim cover has no trackpad
